text: The sources do not fully agree on the 2012 tree-cover loss. The Hansen dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected a 1.4-hectare loss in 2012, but the JRC GFC2020 dataset only corroborates 51% of that area as forest in 2020, meeting the minimum threshold (50%) for partial agreement. The MGAP forest map (2021) indicates the area was not native forest and included 0.4 hectares of planted *Pinus* species. While the JRC and Hansen meet the corroboration rule, the MGAP data suggests the loss may have involved non-native forest. Thus, the sources partially align but differ on forest type and extent.
